candidate_windows.window_text: For MT, we fine-tuned in both directions with a learning-rate of 2e-5 and batch size of 16. We trained for four epochs, and kept the model with the best eval loss. We used a weight decay of 0.01, warmup ratio 0.1, and a cosine annealing scheduler for learning rate. While for ASR finetuning, we fine-tuned with a learning-rate of 1e-3 and batch size of 8 for 20 epochs, as the validation WER continued to drop after preliminary runs with 10 epochs. For S2TT, we fine-tuned for 10 epochs with an optimal learning rate of 3e-4. All training was done on two NVIDIA A40 GPUs.
